## Contribution

Describe the change and why it belongs in the project.

## Verification

State what was checked, identify relevant public sources, and explain any remaining uncertainty. Do not include private context or personal identities.

## Review

- [ ] Content, links, filenames, and commit metadata comply with PRIVACY.md.
- [ ] No private correspondence, account data, or identifying examples were imported.
- [ ] Contributions, quotations, and results are represented accurately.
- [ ] Relative links and relevant factual claims were checked.
- [ ] Publication is within the permission provided.
